common.demoNote: Demo mode: statistics are calculated from local mock data only. No server or database is connected.
common.readOnlyBody: Management cannot create, edit or delete supplier, batch or quality records. Viewing statistics, generating reports and downloading them are available.
common.unitNote: Measurement units are a demo presentation. The system does not define MNS/ISO standards, acceptable limits or a quality verdict.
common.sourceNote: Every metric is derived automatically from suppliers, batches and the latest quality result per batch.
common.emptyHint: No records match the filters. Try changing the period or aimag filter.
common.notFoundHint: The report number may be incorrect or the report may no longer exist.
common.storageError: Could not save. Please try again.

dashboard.title: Management analytics dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Consolidated statistics for suppliers, registered batches, supply amount and the latest quality results.
dashboard.qualityDescription: Averages calculated only from the latest quality result of each batch. This is not a standard or a quality verdict.
dashboard.qualityEmptyHint: Average metrics appear here after test results are entered.
dashboard.trendDescription: Supply amount and batch count per month by registration date.
dashboard.qualityChartDescription: Average yield and fineness from the latest result of each aimag.
dashboard.aimagTableDescription: Aimag statistics ordered by total supply amount.
dashboard.recentDescription: The six most recently registered batches.
dashboard.recentEmptyHint: Batches appear here after the registration clerk records them.
dashboard.openComparisonHint: Compare amount and quality averages by origin.
dashboard.openReportsHint: Generate and download reports by period and origin.

comparison.title: Aimag and soum comparison
comparison.subtitle: Compare registered batch origins, supply amounts and the latest quality results by aimag and soum.
comparison.filterHint: Filters apply to the batch registration date.
comparison.invalidRange: The start date cannot be later than the end date.
comparison.amountChartDescription: Total amount in kg for batches matching the filters.
comparison.qualityChartDescription: Averages calculated from the latest quality result.
comparison.aimagTableDescription: Aimag metrics ordered by total amount.
comparison.soumTableDescription: Soum metrics ordered by total amount.
comparison.emptyHint: No records match the selected period and aimag. Try adjusting the filters.
comparison.note: The comparison only shows recorded counts, amounts and averages from the latest quality results. It is not a quality verdict.

reports.title: Statistics reports
reports.subtitle: Consolidate supplier, batch, supply, quality and origin statistics for a selected period into a report.
reports.generateHint: A report keeps the aggregate snapshot from the moment it was generated. Later registry changes do not alter it.
reports.previewHint: Current metrics calculated with the selected filters.

typeHints.comprehensive: Supplier, batch, supply, quality and aimag/soum sections.
typeHints.supply: Batch count, supply amount, monthly flow and aimag breakdown.
typeHints.quality: Quality averages, testing coverage and quality by aimag/soum.
typeHints.origin: Aimag and soum distribution, supply amount and recent batches.

formatHints.pdf: Save as PDF through the browser print dialog. The preview page opens first.
formatHints.csv: Download a CSV file for Excel. Cyrillic text is supported.

reports.listHint: Reports are append-only. There is no edit or delete action.
reports.emptyHint: Generate the first report using the form on the left.
reports.errorDates: Enter both the start and end dates.
reports.errorRange: The start date cannot be later than the end date.
reports.errorStorage: Could not save the report. Please try again.
reports.snapshotNote: Reports contain no personal data (supplier name, phone, email); only aggregate metrics are stored.

preview.title: Report preview
preview.subtitle: A snapshot of the generated report. Print it or download it as CSV.
preview.notFoundHint: The report number may be incorrect or the report may have been removed.
preview.supplierHint: Total supplier count, status and type distribution.
preview.batchHint: Registered batch count, supply amount and testing coverage.
preview.qualityHint: Averages calculated from the latest result of each batch.
preview.monthlyHint: Batches, amount and testing per month by registration date.
preview.aimagHint: Supply and quality consolidated by origin.
preview.soumHint: Supply and quality consolidated by aimag and soum.
preview.recentHint: The latest batches registered within the report period.
preview.footerNote: This report is an aggregate statistic generated automatically from local mock data in the CashmereTrace demo system. It contains no personal data.
preview.footerUnitNote: Measurement units are a demo presentation; no standards, acceptable limits or quality verdict are defined.
preview.snapshotNote: The data snapshot from the moment of generation is preserved. Later changes do not affect this report.
